block.goal: Extract the cohesive authentication-profile configuration API and state from BaseClient to reduce the number of public methods and simplify BaseClient.

ops.details: Create BaseClientConfiguration in the same package and move the cohesive configuration state and methods for customProperties, profileFactoryWhenNotAuthenticated, multiProfile, and saveProfileInSession: getCustomProperties(), setCustomProperties(Map<String,Object>), getProfileFactoryWhenNotAuthenticated(), setProfileFactoryWhenNotAuthenticated(ProfileFactory), isMultiProfile(WebContext,UserProfile), setMultiProfile(boolean), getSaveProfileInSession(WebContext,UserProfile), and setSaveProfileInSession(boolean). Update BaseClient to delegate required behavior to the extracted configuration object, including the profileFactoryWhenNotAuthenticated branch in getUserProfile(Credentials,WebContext,SessionStore) and the values rendered by toString(). Preserve the existing public behavior and warning logic associated with setProfileFactoryWhenNotAuthenticated(ProfileFactory).
